widgets_values: A colorized photographic scene of a 1920s urban alleyway, historical accuracy. A man in a classic black felt bowler hat, dusty black wool morning coat, baggy dark grey trousers, and an off-white collared shirt stands next to a weathered red brick wall with pale grey mortar. The ground is made of dusty brown dirt and dark soil. In the foreground, dull zinc-grey metallic garbage cans feature light brown rust stains and overflowing  trash. he is holding a brown cane.
